positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed 6+ user-facing features and 3+ reusable UI components for Klue's web application using React
and TypeScript, increasing user retention by 15% and enhancing content quality
• Boosted test coverage by 80% by revamping UI testing and component snapshots with Jest & Storybook
• Collaborated closely with design team of 8+ to ensure responsiveness, design specs in code reviews
• Leveraged OpenAI to build AskKlue, a bot that answers user inquiries with internal resources/database
• Resolved over 40 tickets and participated in 20+ increasingly complex code reviews throughout the term
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Jest · Git · Front-End Development · Design Systems · Responsive Web Design

positions.title: Systems & Security Programmer - Population Data BC (PopData)
positions.description:
• Enhanced a 15+ year-old online database/system by implementing new features with Python, Django
• Increased efficiency by 12% by automating bulk user deletion processes with instant email notifications
• Developed a user-friendly custom document creation feature on the company website for internal use
• Adopted company version control practices with tests on virtual machines and multiple code reviews

positions.title: Junior IT Support Analyst
positions.description:
• Day-to-day faculty and staff helpdesk for technical support (Mac, Windows) using ITSM ServiceNow
• Troubleshooted software and hardware issues for users, contributing to an overall ticket increase of 30%

positions.title: Website Manager
positions.description:

• Launched a complete redesign of the website in January 2021
• Added 4000+ unique visitors on website, fostering deeper engagement with the organization
• WiTech named one of Ten Accomplished Youth Organizations (TAYO Awards) in the National Capital Region in 2019

positions.title: Head Of Logistics

• WiTCon wins Peace Builder of the Year Award 2019

honors.title: 1st Place for Best Hack to Support Women
honors.description:
My team and I won first place for the ‘Best Hack to Support Women’ category against 60+ other projects at HackViolet 2022, a 24-hour female-empowerment hackathon.

Our team built a women’s safety app that uses streetlight map data to guide users through the safest route home using the Google Maps API. We also integrated the Twilio API for an instant text feature that sends the user’s current location to their emergency contacts.

See our presentation here: https://devpost.com/software/lighthouse-pz2tkj

honors.title: Y.P. Heung Foundation Award in Arts
honors.description: Scholarship awarded to UBC Arts students with outstanding academic achievement, with preference for students who demonstrate community involvement. These academic awards are made on the recommendation of the Faculty of Arts.
honors.issuer: Issued by Y.P. Heung Foundation  · Dec 2021

volunteerExperiences.description:
Hayag Pilipinas bridges impoverished Filipino communities and those who wish to help, especially in light of the COVID-19 pandemic.
• Raised PhP48,900+ to provide 27,800 sanitary napkins for the inmates of the Correctional Institute for Women in Mandaluyong, Philippines
• Raised PhP350,000+ to provide tablets to 100+ scholars who were previously unable to attend school due to online learning
• Raised PhP1.5+ million to help rebuild typhoon-stricken communities of Bicol

Instagram: @hayag.phl
